info.ultimaratio.caesar: The CAESAR Mk1 is the French self-propelled howitzer: a 155 mm/52-calibre gun on a 6x6 truck, built to shoot and move off before counter-battery fire arrives. As soon as the gunner aims, the crew lowers the rear spades and steadies the truck (5 s) before the gun can lay; pressing forward or back packs it up again (5 s). Fires armour-piercing, high-explosive, cluster and white-phosphorus shells, one about every 7 s. Can be laid with an Artillery Indicator.
info.ultimaratio.mamba: The SAMP/T MAMBA is the Franco-Italian long-range air-defence launcher: eight ASTER-30 missiles that intercept aircraft, drones, cruise and ballistic missiles. With the gunner aboard and the truck stopped, it steadies itself and raises its launcher (about 20 s); it only fires deployed and packs up when driven. Shift + right click it (the first player becomes its owner) to switch its automatic mode: unmanned, it then engages enemy aircraft and hostile mobs above it, and every enemy missile a friendly radar sees. Reload: 60 s.
info.ultimaratio.hades: A what-if: the HADES tactical ballistic missile, withdrawn from French service in 1997, brought back on today's Renault Kerax 8x8. Like the MAMBA it steadies itself and raises its launcher before firing. The gunner locks a target block and the missile flies to it. Two missiles, a 36-block blast each; reload: 20 s.
info.ultimaratio.mamba_radar: The ARABEL is the acquisition and fire-control radar of the SAMP/T battery, on a Renault Kerax. It has no weapons. Shift + right click it to raise the radar (active) or fold it (inactive). It needs energy: it will not deploy without it, uses twice a FuMO-25's energy while up and folds by itself once empty. Whatever it sees goes to your side's tactical map, and the MAMBA in automatic mode engages the enemy missiles it tracks. Range: 1000 blocks by default (configurable).
info.ultimaratio.samp_t_ng: The SAMP/T NG carries the Ground Fire 300 radar of the new-generation battery on a Renault Kerax 8x8. It has no weapons. Shift + right click it to raise the radar (active) or fold it (inactive). It needs energy: it will not deploy without it, uses twice a FuMO-25's energy while up and folds by itself once empty. Whatever it sees goes to your side's tactical map, and the MAMBA in automatic mode engages the enemy missiles it tracks. Range: 2000 blocks by default (configurable).
info.ultimaratio.thundart: The THUNDART is a French rocket launcher of the HIMARS class: an 8-round pod of unguided precision rockets on a truck. Designate a target with an Artillery Indicator and the launcher lays itself on the firing solution. The pod stows over the cab while driving and lays again on the current fire mission when you stop. Elevation 0-67°; reload of a full pod: 60 s.
info.ultimaratio.renault_kerax: The Renault Kerax is a French 8x8 heavy truck, the chassis of the SAMP/T battery. This one is the unarmed version, for a driver and a passenger.
info.ultimaratio.vbmr: The VBMR Griffon is the French 6x6 multi-role armoured vehicle, carrying a full infantry section under armour. Its remote 12.7 mm weapon station covers the vehicle without exposing the gunner, who can also fire the smoke dischargers.
info.ultimaratio.vbmr_mepac: The VBMR Griffon MEPAC is the mortar carrier of the Griffon family: a 2R2M 81 mm mortar fires from the rear compartment once the roof hatches are open, and only while the vehicle stands still. A remote 12.7 mm weapon station on the roof keeps covering it. Can be laid with an Artillery Indicator.
info.ultimaratio.vab_p: The VAB P is the French 4x4 armoured personnel carrier: a driver, a turret gunner and four infantrymen in the rear. The roof turret carries a 7.62 mm machine gun.
info.ultimaratio.serval: The VBMR-L Serval is the French 4x4 light multi-role armoured vehicle, with six aboard: a driver, a gunner and four infantrymen. Its remote 12.7 mm weapon station covers the vehicle without exposing the gunner. The rear steps fold down when it stops.
info.ultimaratio.serval_dsa: The VBMR-L Serval DSA is the short-range air-defence version of the Serval: two Mistral missiles ready in their tubes on the roof turret, plus a 7.62 mm machine gun. The rear steps fold down when it stops.
info.ultimaratio.serval_lad: The VBMR-L Serval LAD is the counter-drone version of the Serval: a roof turret with a 30 mm ARX30 cannon firing grapeshot (or anti-air shells). Crew it from the gunner seat, or Shift + right click it (the first player becomes its owner) to switch on the automatic turret: unmanned, it shoots hostile drones and phantoms within 50 blocks. The rear steps fold down when it stops.
info.ultimaratio.leclerc_xlr: The Leclerc XLR is the latest standard of the French main battle tank: a 120 mm CN120-26 gun with a coaxial machine gun, and a remote 12.7 mm weapon station for the commander. Three crew: gunner, commander and driver.
info.ultimaratio.leclerc_azur: The Leclerc AZUR is the urban-combat kit of the Leclerc: slat armour at the rear and a remote 7.62 mm weapon station for the commander. The 120 mm CN120-26 gun and its coaxial machine gun stay. Three crew: gunner, commander and driver.
info.ultimaratio.rafale_c: The Dassault Rafale C is the single-seat multirole fighter of the French Air and Space Force, in its F3 standard: a twin-engine delta-canard airframe roughly twice as fast as the A-10. Weapons: 30 mm DEFA cannon (1), MICA medium-range or METEOR long-range air-to-air missiles (2, switch ammo with the fire-mode key), Mk 82 bombs (3), Mk 84 bombs (4) and a SCALP-EG cruise missile (5). Sprint for the afterburner; the landing-gear key retracts the gear.
info.ultimaratio.tigre: The EC665 Tigre HAP is the Franco-German tandem-seat attack helicopter in its escort and fire-support version. The pilot, in the rear seat, flies and fires the 68 mm rocket pods (44 rockets) and the Kh-39 missiles; the gunner, in front, aims through the roof sight with the chin-mounted 30 mm AM-30781 cannon (AP or HE) and the cursor-following 9M120 wire-guided missiles. Lighter and more agile than the Mi-28, but less armoured.
info.ultimaratio.as350: The AS350 Écureuil is a light single-engine utility helicopter, fast and agile. Unarmed: a pilot, a passenger beside them and two more in the back.
info.ultimaratio.vsr700: The Airbus VSR700 is an unmanned tactical helicopter derived from the Cabri G2. Nobody boards it: fly it from a VSR Monitor or a Ground Control Station while your body stays where you stand, still vulnerable. Weapons: two Mistral missiles that follow where the drone points (1) and a laser designator (2), a zoomable sensor camera that holds the point it looks at. A small radar shows what flies around it. The link is lost beyond 2500 blocks.
info.ultimaratio.mq9_reaper: The General Atomics MQ-9 Reaper is the medium-altitude long-endurance drone of the French Air and Space Force: one turboprop pushing from the rear and a sensor ball under the nose. Flown like the VSR700 from a VSR Monitor or a Ground Control Station, but as an airplane: take off, fly and land it from where you stand. Weapons: two AGM-114 Hellfire missiles that ride the sensor camera's line of sight (1), two GBU-12 bombs (2) and the laser designator (3). Let go of the controls in the air and it circles over that point; it can also be sent somewhere from the tactical map. The landing-gear key retracts the gear. The link is lost beyond 5000 blocks.
des.ultimaratio.vsr_monitor.usage_1: Right click a VSR700 or MQ-9 to link it.
des.ultimaratio.vsr_monitor.usage_2: Right click in the air to take or release the controls.
des.ultimaratio.vsr_monitor.usage_3: Sneak + right click in the air to unlink.
des.ultimaratio.gcs.1: Right click it to fly any drone of your side in range,
des.ultimaratio.gcs.2: no monitor needed. The dismount key or walking away lets go.
des.ultimaratio.gcs.3: Needs a little FE to run.
gui.ultimaratio.gcs.title: Select a drone
gui.ultimaratio.gcs.none: No drone of your side in range
tips.ultimaratio.gcs.no_power: No power: the GCS needs FE
des.ultimaratio.gf300.1: A 3 x 3 x 6 surveillance radar that works like the FuMO-25,
des.ultimaratio.gf300.2: with a longer range and a wider sector.
des.ultimaratio.gf300.3: Feed it FE; right click it to choose its mode.
